responsibility: This file is the aggregation and support point for text-art selftests under CHECKING_P. It runs the module’s per-file test suites in one place and provides the assert_canvas_streq helpers that render canvases through pretty_printer instances and compare the resulting serialized text, making it the common test harness layer for validating canvas-based rendering behavior across the subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the implementation and aggregation point for this module’s selftest runners and canvas assertion helpers; unlike gcc/text-art/selftests.h, it defines the dispatcher and helper bodies rather than just exposing them.
